title: Make It Walk
intro: One pitch is a drone. Give the line somewhere to go: Tab to a lit bass note (or click it off and back on, which places and focuses it) and press ↑ or ↓ to move it in semitones (shift moves a whole octave). Keep the root on most of the steps and lift a few — an octave jump and one note in between are plenty. Three different pitches across the line and it starts to walk.
